title: FTC requests comment on AI accuracy policy
verifiedFacts: The FTC sought public comment on a proposed policy statement concerning AI objectivity, accuracy, and potentially deceptive conduct.
inference: Claims about system truthfulness and output integrity may require more explicit evidence trails and product disclosures.
significance: Strengthens the case for provenance receipts, fact-inference separation, and inspectable governance in AI products.
assumptions: The proposal may influence later enforcement or product expectations.
knownLimitations: A proposed policy is not a final rule or adjudicated standard.
